an_empty_graph_can_be_saved_but_not: An empty graph can be saved, but not launched.
applies_only_to_this_node_the_template_s: Applies only to this node. The template stays unchanged. Another credential replaces only the same kind.
choose_edge_type: When should this edge start the target?
colors_show_the_run_a_click_shows_the: Colors show the run. A click shows the output.
connect_click_or_drag_target: Connecting from {name}. Click or press Enter or Space on a target node, or drag from the source to it. Press Escape or click the canvas to cancel.
connect_help: Pick a target by clicking it or dragging to it, then choose the edge type. Each edge has its own row below; change its target or remove it there.
delete_this_node: Delete node "{name}"? Its connections are removed.
delete_this_workflow: Delete workflow "{name}"? Its schedules are removed.
drag_nodes_and_use_the_canvas_menus: Drag nodes or move them with the arrow keys. Drag empty canvas to pan. Right-click empty canvas to add a node. Right-click a node or use its menu to edit, delete, or connect it; Enter opens Edit.
empty_workflows: Workflows chain templates with success, failure, and always edges.
extra_variables_are_not_valid_json: Extra variables are not valid JSON.
forks_is_a_number_from_1_to_50: Forks is a number from 1 to 50.
green_is_successful_red_is_failed_blue_i: Green is successful, red is failed, blue is running.
launch_unsaved_changes_hint: This workflow has unsaved changes. Launch last saved version uses the last saved graph.
right_click_empty_canvas_to_add_a_node: Right-click empty canvas to add a node.
run_keyboard_help: Keyboard: Tab to a node and press Enter or Space to open its output.
select_a_node_to_connect_it: Select a node to connect it.
this_node_has_no_output_yet: This node has no output yet.
workflow_keyboard_help: Keyboard: Tab to a node or edge. Enter or Space opens or selects it, and Delete removes the focused edge or node. In connect mode, Enter or Space on the target connects it and Escape cancels. Shift+F10 opens the canvas menu. Use + and − to zoom, 0 resets to 100 %, F fits the graph, and Ctrl+wheel zooms.
